summary: ATA Creativity Global filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of two directors (Jun Zhang and Andrew Y. Yan) effective June 30, 2026, due to personal reasons with no disagreement with the company, and the appointment of two new directors (Ruobai Sima, also the CFO, and Han Jiang) effective July 1, 2026. Sima receives $10,000 annual compensation; Jiang serves without compensation. The changes are routine board refreshment, not forced or abrupt departures. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics apply.
